page.content:
Assassination art Gouken reformed for Ryu and Ken.

How Ansatsuken connects

  • Character: Gouken — Gouken teaches the non-killing form of Ansatsuken.
  • Topic: Street Fighter — Ansatsuken is the martial art at the core of Street Fighter.

What is Ansatsuken?

Ansatsuken is the martial art behind the Hadoken and Shoryuken. Gouken taught a non-killing form; Akuma kept the Satsui no Hadou that the style was meant to restrain.

Key threads lead to Gouken and Street Fighter.
